title: cipher left open (openvpn) — review required
description: cipher runs with an open setting: ciphers+none. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply an AEAD cipher and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
